verdict.rationale: The evidence offers only adjacent building blocks for bulk work. Workflows can run steps simultaneously with `.parallel()`, code mode can run multi-tool computations in a sandbox and return one result, and background tasks can dispatch long-running tool calls. None of these is documented as a bulk or batch operation over many items. missing for 10: an explicit batch/foreach primitive for applying one operation across a collection, documented concurrency or batch-size controls, per-item error handling for bulk runs, independent or hands-on corroboration of bulk processing.
